rootCause: The session ownership gate used redirect:error, which workerd rejects before any outbound request; Request.cache also fails on older compatibility dates.

fix.redirect: manual with non-2xx rejection before session admission
fix.freshness: authenticated fixed-origin POST with request Cache-Control:no-store; response private/no-store retained
fix.icon: visible red Encar fallback while PNG is unavailable; sold visibility applied independently of lookup module initialization

workerd.before: 503/RPC_NETWORK_ERROR with zero outbound RPC calls on both dates
workerd.after: ACTIVE/LEGACY: one RPC then handler; REPLACED:401; redirect:503, no follow or handler

limitations: Actual production confirmation after deploying this fix is pending the user retry.
Local runtime and browser fixtures do not verify current official Encar advertisements.
